name: Power Of Attorney Legalisation 1 Code
definition: Indicates the legal constraint on the Power of Attorney.

NOTA.name: Notary
NOTA.definition: Indicates that the power of attorney must be legalised by a notary.

LOCA.name: Local Authority
LOCA.definition: Indicates that the power of attorney must be legalised by a local authority.

APOS.name: Apostilled
APOS.definition: Indicates that the power of attorney must be legalised by a legal officer.

COUN.name: Consularized
COUN.definition: Indicates that the power of attorney must be legalised by a consular officer.
